webhooks.detail: Events API: subscribe to event types per app; HTTP endpoint or Socket Mode; retries; scopes gate events

evidence.quote: When you use the Events API, Slack calls you.

sandbox.detail: Free Slack Developer Program; every enrolled dev can provision a basic Enterprise-org sandbox at no extra cost (extras need paid plan/payment method)

evidence.quote: Every developer enrolled in the Slack Developer Program is eligible to provision a basic sandbox.

rate_limits.summary: Web API 4 tiers, per method/workspace/app, per-minute windows (Tier1 1+/min to Tier4 100+/min); Events API 30k deliveries/workspace/hr

evidence.quote: Rate limit windows are per minute.
